title: Prove ConPTY and Job Object lifecycle
commit_note: The supplied bootstrap workspace is not a Git checkout; authority, manifest, dispatch, and archive hashes are used as immutable references.
implementation_summary: Added an isolated five-project Windows x64 proof solution for native ConPTY/Job Object hosting, deterministic fixtures, owner-crash containment, a manifest-driven harness, and dependency-free contract tests.

Implemented suspended root creation, Job Object assignment and membership verification before resume, synchronous ConPTY channels, one dedicated blocking output reader, UTF-8 input/output, resize, graceful Ctrl+C, explicit hard stop, accounting, bounded teardown, and exact process-identity leak checks.

Added eleven canonical lifecycle scenarios, 100-run reliability defaults, per-scenario 1/4/8-session scale groups, resource/process/handle evidence, strict JSON evidence, source/dispatch identity binding, and fail-closed diagnostic-versus-acceptance status rules.
Documented the selected reattachment boundary: this leaf design has no surviving broker or transferable ConPTY/Job handles and therefore does not claim live PTY reattachment after owner failure.
